tiers: Dear whoever keeps checking on me: I think someone is watching over me. Hello?
Dear unseen friend, I keep finding nice surprises. I suspect you. Thank you.
Dear friend, I told a pigeon about you today. It seemed impressed.
Dear friend, some days the streets feel kinder. I think that's you.
Dear friend, I saved you the best bench in the park. It's the one with the view.
Dear friend, wherever I walk next, I'll tell you about it. You always listen.
Dear friend, I don't know who you are, but you're the best part of every city.
Dear friend, if I ever see a dragon, you'll be the first to know.

thanks.snack: Dear whoever keeps sending snacks: I was starving. Thank you.
thanks.coffee: Dear whoever sends coffee: it found me at exactly the right moment.
thanks.umbrella: Dear whoever keeps sending umbrellas, thank you. It has not rained once.
thanks.guide: Dear friend, the city guide was great. I now know three facts about drains.
thanks.clover: Dear friend, the clover worked. I found a coin, then a nicer coin.
